_comment: Boardwright pipeline graph, read by plan.py. kind: model | script | helper | user | gate. needs = dependencies; loop_to = where work returns when a gate fails (not a dependency); invalidated_by = design files (sch, pcb, dru, pro) whose change reopens the node; when = hazardous | fast | machine_assembly. Evidence (auto-detected completion): file, file_contains [file, text], gate (row of reports/gates.json), json_ok (+ true_key or zero_key), glob_min [pattern, n], config_key (boardwright.json). A gate node must have evidence and can never be marked done by hand.

nodes.title: Interview: use, power, connectors, size, environment, assembly, country, suppliers
Write 01-spec.md: requirements table, block diagram, interfaces, standard, board class
Confirm the spec and every ASSUMPTION row (every requirement has a value and a source)
Choose parts (assembly method, supplier stock, packages)
Download each datasheet PDF into datasheets/ (ask user if blocked)
Index datasheets, list parts without a facts file
Read each datasheet (one helper per part): pins, ratings, land pattern with pages
Quick stock and lifecycle pass over the non-passive parts
Check pin table vs symbol and land pattern vs footprint; write MPN/LCSC/Datasheet fields
Independent second look at the parts report: every pin table against its datasheet page
Gate: 02-parts.md PASS (every part has a datasheet and a cited pin table)
Power tree, worst-case current per rail, headroom, dissipation, junction temperature
Gate: 03-power.md PASS (every rail >= 20% headroom, no part over its Tj)
Create the KiCad project (one .kicad_pro, root .kicad_sch and .kicad_pcb)
Draw the schematic with the schematic tools
Gate: sch_check.py has 0 errors
Gate: ERC has 0 errors
Write 04-schematic.md: ERC counts, each warning explained
Stackup, design rules, net classes as patterns, .kicad_dru, expect_netclass_patterns
Gate: rule guard passes
Confirm board outline, mounting holes, connector positions
Write the floorplan: blocks in current-flow order, critical loops per block
Place connectors, holes, power path, each IC with its decoupling
Measure critical loops and read the unrouted list before routing
nodes.run: KiCad python: scripts/emc_geometry.py . ; scripts/board_digest.py . (unrouted section) ; scripts/block_check.py . (decoupling and protection distances on the placement)

nodes.title: Review the placement before any routing
Route mains, switch nodes, high-current paths, feedback (coordinates; pcb-mechanic may push)
Route the remaining signals
Pours last, refilled under the full rule set; none inside a hazardous area
Gate: DRC with schematic parity 0 errors, 0 unconnected
Gate: isolation barrier check passes
Once per project: prove on a scratch copy that a deliberate violation raises an error
Measure block rules on the routed board: decoupling, protection parts, crystal, I2C pull-ups, track width
Independent second look at the layout: rules cover the spec, distances, gate numbers
Gate: 05-layout.md PASS (rule table, distances, DRC counts)
Fill the emc section of boardwright.json: loops, switch nodes, distances, limits with sources
Run the EMC geometry checks
Controlled-impedance and fast nets: target Z0, stackup, length matching (high-speed.md)
Rate each finding CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW; propose fixes (schematic changes need approval)
Independent second look at the EMC findings and their ratings
Gate: 06-emc.md PASS (no CRITICAL finding)
Export the BOM: reference, value, footprint, MPN, supplier number
Stock, price, lifecycle per BOM batch
Hand-check lines LCSC does not cover (suppliers.md); read the numbers
Machine assembly: every line stocked by the assembler, library type and setup fees noted
Gate: 07-bom.md PASS (no end-of-life, no out-of-stock part)
Refill zones on a copy, rerun DRC, export Gerbers, drill, placement, BOM into fab/
Check the exported files: BOM against placement designators, paste layers not empty
